column1: # Size in bytes of each GALA program in testdata/, built by measure.sh for
# linux/amd64 with Go 1.25.5 (the go.mod version, which the binary-size CI
# job builds with), using a CLI built from master just after the 0.103.0
# release. Unstripped binaries embed the absolute path of their .gala source,
# so these lines can differ from a run in another directory, or from the
# release-CLI numbers on the website, by up to a few hundred bytes.
# CI fails when a GALA binary is more than MARGIN_PERCENT (10) above its line.
# When a change grows a binary on purpose, or a Go upgrade moves every size,
# rerun measure.sh with the new CLI and Go, copy the gala_bytes column of
# sizes.tsv here, and say why in the PR description. When a change shrinks a
# binary, lower its line here too, so later growth is measured from the new
